data.name: Kalindi
data.gender_notes: Kalindi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit kālindī, the river Yamuna. Its root is Sanskrit kālindī (कालिन्दी). Kalindi, wife of Krishna; the Yamuna river. Kalindi is a Sanskrit name meaning “Of the Yamuna river”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kalindi expresses “Of the Yamuna river”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit kālindī, the river Yamuna.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalindi total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
